newsitem.title: USA: CIDCO sees Q4 operating loss as expenses rise.
newsitem.headline: CIDCO sees Q4 operating loss as expenses rise.

text.p: CIDCO Inc on Wednesday said it expected to report a slight net profit and a small operating loss for the fourth quarter as its expenses rose and its gross margin fell.
The telephone-equipment maker said in a statement it generated about $57 million in revenue in the three months ended December 31, up from $51.3 million in the year-earlier quarter.

The company did not not give a precise estimate of net income for the most recent quarter. Analysts had expected the company to post earnings of $0.38 a share, according to First Call. In the comparable period of 1995, CIDCO earned $0.35 a share.
CIDCO said sales and marketing expenses rose by about $9 million from the third quarter as it intensified direct marketing of its products. The costs significantly exceeded company expectations.
Also, during the fourth quarter, the company said a $2.5 million reserve was recorded for bad debt related to customers of a regional bell operating company.
CIDCO plans to report fourth-quarter results during the week of January 27.
"We are very disappointed with our performance in the fourth quarter," said President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Locklin.

"We still believe this direct-marketing approach best addresses our customers' needs. However, we obviously need to change our current price structure and better control our sales and marketing expenses," he added.
CIDCO makes network feature telephones and caller-identification display units, advanced cordless telephones and smart screen phones.
